source: Named production failures only. HyperAgent career-application-loop (check.js + rules v1.3) lived as cloud skill scripts, did not hard-stop the chain when Profile was skipped, and allowed a builder to declare a role did not need a Profile. Canon lives in this repo because Profiles ship at ai.drsfilms.com/{company}/. Encode those failures. Do not dump speculative L0 lists.

rules.failure: skip-Profile / builder-declared waiver
rules.note: Nobody — harness, README, or Brief waivers[] / waived / exemptions — may waive Profile.

rules.failure: missing CL / builder-declared waiver
rules.note: Cover letter cannot be waived. If an ATS has no cover field, the CL still exists as a file.

rules.failure: skip-Profile / skip-CL prose
patterns: 跳过.{0,16}(简介|角色页|作品页|profile|封面|求职信)
省略.{0,16}(简介|角色页|作品页|profile|封面|求职信)
(不需要|无需|不用|不必).{0,16}(简介|角色页|作品页|profile|封面信|封面|求职信|cover letter)
(简介|角色页|profile|封面信|求职信).{0,8}(可跳过|可省略|不需要|无需|可选)
(profile|cover letter|role[- ]specific profile).{0,48}(out of scope|not in scope)
先不做.{0,20}(公司)?(专页|简介|角色页|profile|封面|求职信)
(专页|公司专页|角色页|简介|profile).{0,16}(先不做|不做了|不要了|先放一放|放一放)
(这轮先|这次先).{0,16}(放一放|不做|省略|跳过|不要)
专页.{0,16}(可跳过|可省略|不需要|无需|可选|先放)

rules.failure: text-only company Profile / no real work stills
rules.note: Company Profile HTML must contain real work images: with a real src. Empty, placeholder, spacer, 1x1, decorative, or missing stills are REJECT. Text-only pages fail. Local HTML without stills fails. Images are not optional. No waiver.

rules.failure: blank first viewport / min-height hero spacer with no still
rules.note: A .hero / header with min-height >= 70vh and no is REJECT (the Giant Spoon #18 78vh fail). A later thumb does not save an empty first viewport. No waiver. _CAREER B-C6 / B-C4 / B-P3.

rules.failure: type-only open / stills below a long text hero (Wonder/Kalshi class)
rules.note: First real must appear within 80 words of visible body text. A Kalshi/Wonder type hero with posters below the fold is REJECT (B-C6 / B-WKS4 / B-P3). No waiver.

rules.failure: two films / thin thumb strip standing in for a work page
rules.note: At least 4 real work images. B-WKS4: 作品多、话少、没照片。两个片子撑不起一页. BPI 3-thumb and #18 1-thumb classes REJECT. No waiver.

rules.failure: AI-only work stack / traditional credits missing
rules.note: Brief History or traditional showreel must be named on the page. B-WKS5: 传统 film/brand credits 必须页内可见，不能只剩 AI 片. No waiver.

rules.failure: AI/3D in the lead slot on a shooting/production seat
rules.note: First recognized work title must be traditional (Brief History / showreel), not One Click Mute / Manga Cut / DoomBrush. B-WKS6. No waiver.

rules.failure: AI stack out of canon order / swapped covers
rules.note: When two or more of the named AI films appear, order is One Click Mute → Manga Cut → DoomBrush, rest after. B-WKS3. No waiver.

rules.failure: traditional Vimeo folded into a modal / not on the card
rules.note: If Brief History or showreel is claimed, player.vimeo.com must be iframed on the card, not only in .modal. B-WKS7. No waiver.

rules.failure: patch-on-old-shell / leftover 70vh+ hero box
rules.note: A .hero / header min-height >= 70vh is the #18 / Luma shell. REJECT even if an was stuffed into that hero. B-C5: 不要打补丁，整页重蒸. No waiver.

rules.failure: R-VI token-only / hex+font with no usage notes
rules.note: A VI record that lists hex/font/radius but does not say how they are used (wordmark/field/canvas) is a token-only distill. Official Giant Spoon is Klein Blue as wordmark/field on a white canvas. Distill without USAGE is REJECT. No waiver.

rules.failure: chrome-only Giant Spoon distill / home hero treated as the brand
rules.note: Official Giant Spoon audit (giantspoon.com, 2026-08-18): chrome-only distill is REJECT even if hex/font match. Home hero type-only white is chrome, not the brand. Distill must include work/case pages: full-bleed autoplay video work cards + per-project duotone scrims; gradients #337789→#2D434B, #BA2210→#2D4654, #01388B→#4E2652, #775714→#665B3A; Yeti #D26403; HBO oxblood/black; home 6 videos + 29 images; zero illustration. Flood fields (services/contact #0033A0, logo garden #000000) are chrome, not a substitute for content. Off Giant Spoon this check is N/A. No waiver.

rules.failure: primary hex only in tiny labels / B/W/navy résumé after a token distill
rules.note: When profile HTML is present, the primary brand color must be a real field or wordmark, not 10px labels on a black/white page. A black/white/navy résumé page is R-VI FAIL even when hex/font match. Footer/closing-only or hover washes do not count. No waiver.

rules.failure: text-only showreel card / A-SHOWREEL-TRAD described in a paragraph
rules.note: If a showreel is claimed, it must be a 21:9 poster + play on the card, not a paragraph, iframe-only IN-CARD kicker, or 16:9 text card. Recruiter 6-second FAIL. No waiver.

rules.failure: legal-paragraph-as-credits / brand marks as a grey wall
rules.note: Brand credits as a long hedging paragraph are REJECT. Marks are marks, not a legal wall. Recruiter 6-second FAIL. No waiver.

rules.failure: internal asset ids visible on the public page
rules.note: A-SHOWREEL-TRAD, A-WORKFLOW-6STAGE, A-WORKFLOW-58NODE, A-TOOL-PROMPTBUILDER, A-TOOLS-DEV4, A-FILM-* must not appear as visible public copy. They are harness ids, not recruiter chrome. No waiver.

rules.failure: assets dumped instead of invoked by JD archetype
rules.note: P-led: reel as picture + brand hang (still, or Coach Vimeo 190660903 if INDEX has no still); no 58-node file; no DEV4 suite; Prompt Builder at most one public:true screenshot, not a gallery/tools wall; 6-stage only in the method slot when JD has process/gates as must-or-should, as one reskin picture. O-led: 6-stage required (DOC-6/R8). A-led (Wonder exam): films first; 58-node file legal only on /wonder/ until generic public:true. Visible A-* ids REJECT. Do not copy HyperAgent files. No waiver.

rules.failure: empty white work cards / brand boxes with no stills
rules.note: A work-card or brand-mark row without a real still is an empty white card. Recruiter 6-second FAIL. No waiver.

rules.failure: brand wordmarks standing in for brand stills
rules.note: If COACH/Nike/BMW/Tencent are claimed, they must be hung — not typeset wordmarks. Hang = dual-gate still, Coach in-page Vimeo 190660903 when INDEX has no still, or a Tencent heading type card when INDEX has no game still. Do not invent frames. No waiver.

rules.failure: P-led 6-stage dumped as a text grid / 7-stage / missing locked footnote
rules.note:
A-WORKFLOW-6STAGE is READY in assets.json (Drive PNG 1hZxTsSjSSvLRkpFe4-8jDSKbWN_HPkz5, sha 0cb95ffb…) but not yet in DRS INDEX. Non-Wonder pages must reskin; never mix 6 vs 7/58 in captions. P-led: not the lead; method slot only if JD has process/gates as must-or-should and the strip is a picture, not six

boxes. O-led: required (DOC-6/R8). A-led: supporting only. No waiver.

rules.failure: outward image hung without assets.json external_ready:true AND INDEX public:true
rules.note: A hung file requires both bits. Text may cite a READY-but-private asset. In-development labels do not waive INDEX. Catalog: harness/rules/asset-clearance.json. No waiver.

rules.failure: A-WORKFLOW-58NODE file hung off /wonder/
rules.note: 58-node graphic is only legal on /wonder/ until a generic public version is READY + DRS public:true. Other routes hanging the file = REJECT. Text cite is not a hang. No waiver.

rules.failure: A-TOOLS-DEV4 screenshot hung (public:false)
rules.note: ai-film-studio-ui-01, coda-ui-01, martini-ui-01, ttl-breakdown-ui-01 are INDEX public:false. Hanging them is REJECT. In-development label does not waive INDEX. prompt-builder-ui-01 is the only public:true product shot today. No waiver.

rules.failure: P-led Prompt Builder gallery / product-UI suite
rules.note: P-led may hang prompt-builder-ui-01 once as a supporting screenshot. Multiple UI stills, or a product shot in a tools section, is a gallery = REJECT. No DEV4 suite. Off P-led this check is N/A. No waiver.

rules.failure: company homepage skin standing in for a role Profile
rules.note: Page must name a production role and at least two work-sample titles. A marketing homepage with decorative stills is REJECT. B-EL1. No waiver.

rules.failure: Brief has selected work ids but no locked page slot order
rules.note: Page composition is locked at analysis. Brief YAML must have selected_work_ids lead-first AND page_slots (or equivalent frontmatter) with archetype, lead, second, supporting, omit. Missing slot order is REJECT. Giant Spoon shipped as a movie page because the lead was not locked here.

rules.failure: P-led agency/producer Brief lead is indie-film-only while ads/reel ids are in the list
rules.note: A P-led agency/producer Brief whose lead is BHOAF/indie-film-only while ads/reel ids sit in selected_work_ids is REJECT. Do not let later hops substitute film stills for the ad/reel lead. Giant Spoon exam.

rules.failure: Brief lead id has no dual-gate still; later hops must not substitute another category
rules.note: If a lead id cannot be hung (assets.json external_ready:true AND INDEX public:true), R0 is REPAIR. Do not allow R2 to hang whatever else is public. Uncatalogued fixture ids are N/A.

rules.failure: Profile first viewport / first work row ignores Brief page_slots.lead
rules.note: First viewport or first work row must match Brief page_slots.lead (ids or named category: trad reel, brand spot). A page that is only film stills while Brief lead is ads/reel is REJECT. Giant Spoon live hung BHOAF ×4; the Profile must follow the Brief ads lead. No waiver.

rules.failure: new Profile judged against a frozen pair / stale compared_to, or a résumé page while the current bar has a first-viewport still
rules.note: Every NEW company Profile is built and judged against the most recently shipped public/*/index.html pages, not a fixed pair (not ElevenLabs/Luma forever, not Wonder/Kalshi forever). Discover peers: every public/*/index.html except the package company. Sort by last git commit timestamp that touched that file (git log -1 --format=%ct -- path); if git is unavailable, fall back to mtime and say so on the check. Newest 3 routes = the bar; write them on the check as compared_to. ACCEPT only if the package records those same 3 on manifest compared_to. A stale fixed pair while newer pages exist is REJECT. Also REJECT if the new local/live HTML is a text/résumé page (0 work images / empty first viewport) while any of the newest 3 have a first-viewport still. Reuses r2-profile-work-images / r2-profile-first-viewport-still gates. No waiver.

rules.failure: generic homepage substituted for role-specific Profile
skip-Profile at closeout (HyperAgent)
rules.note: Apply package is always CV + cover letter + a real company Profile. Qualifying live evidence is HTTP 2xx AND a dedicated-profile marker (route/slug path identity; tiny tokens like Meta must not match metadata). Local HTML or SPA 200 empty shell is not enough. R3 independently re-runs claim-lock, slop, skip-language, waiver, and R-VI provenance on current files. Disk ACCEPT / id+PASS stubs cannot waive those gates.

rules.failure: generic homepage / mismatched Profile URL in CV or CL
anti-AI-slop treated as looks-fine
